title: Loopbase Event v1
description: One immutable line in the append-only evidence log. Every state transition writes one.

id.description: Unique id of this event; other events reference it through caused_by.

run_id.description: Identity of the run that produced this event. One log file may hold several runs.

actor.description: Which kernel component wrote this event.

caused_by.description: Id of the event that triggered this one; null for the root event of a run.

kind.description: Event type, e.g. goal.start / model.response / tool.call.
